'''Migraine''' was a condition characterized by a severe, painful, recurring [[Headache/Legends|headache]].

[[Beldorion]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] would occasionally use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to inflict painful migraines on his servant, [[Liegeus Vorn]], as a form of punishment.<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />
